title: Practice 5: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: У нас слишком много ___ (бытовой) техники.
exercises.prompt: We have too many household appliances.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «техники»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The road closure was due to a flash flood.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «паводка»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ты достиг ___ (брачный) возраста.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «возраста»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mary wants the nice picture of a penguin from Tom's profile.
exercises.ru: Мария хочет милую картинку пингвина из ___ профиля Тома.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «профиля»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «знаков»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The Pilgrims came to America, fleeing religious persecution.

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «гонений»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я вернулся в родную деревню после ___ (двухлетний) отсутствия.
exercises.prompt: I returned to my native village after two years' absence.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «отсутствия»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The teacher made the students do a lot of homework.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «работы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В моей стране не так уж много ___ (некоммерческий) организаций.
exercises.prompt: There aren't that many nonprofit organizations in my country.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «организаций»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm against racial segregation.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «сегрегации»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Гюнтер услышал пять ___ (последовательный) щелчков.
exercises.prompt: Gunter heard five snaps in rapid succession.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «щелчков»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Esperanto doesn't have double negatives, but Russian does.
exercises.ru: В эсперанто нет ___ отрицания, а в русском есть.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «отрицания»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я категорически против ___ (телесный) наказаний.
exercises.prompt: I'm firmly opposed to corporal punishment.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «наказаний»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Kwanzaa is celebrated from December 26 to January 1.
exercises.ru: Кванзаа отмечается с двадцать ___ декабря по первое января.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «декабря»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Лишь через пять-десять лет технология достигнет ___ (необходимый) уровня.
exercises.prompt: It will take five to ten years for the technology to be ready.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «уровня»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I don't see much choice.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «выбора»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он вернулся с ___ (пятничный) молитвы.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «молитвы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The hospital quarantined the infected patients to avoid cross infection.
exercises.ru: Больница поместила в карантин заражённых пациентов, чтобы избежать ___ заражения.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «заражения»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Предложения начинаются с ___ (заглавный) буквы.
exercises.prompt: Sentences begin with a capital letter.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «буквы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We don't have a dishwasher.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «машины»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
